false_green_rate.definition: share of units whose recorded first-pass verdict is PASS but whose artifacts do not read back byte-identical from an immutable Git object

first_pass_acceptance_rate.definition: share of units carrying a terminal independent disposition that were ACCEPTED on the first attempt
missing_inputs: non-empty population: rows whose independent_disposition is ACCEPTED or REJECTED matched 0 of 64 recorded rows
first_pass_acceptance_rate.population: rows whose independent_disposition is ACCEPTED or REJECTED

independently_accepted_throughput.definition: count of counted units with a terminal ACCEPTED independent disposition and a VERIFIED read-back, divided by the observation window in hours
missing_inputs: observation_window_hours: no absolute attempt start or end timestamp exists in the frozen required_fields of PO03-METRIC-DEFINITIONS-v1, so no time base can be derived from the recorded rows alone

lesson_to_live_change_conversion.definition: share of accepted lessons that produced a live mechanism change with preserved lineage
missing_inputs: accepted_lesson_ledger: no accepted-lesson field exists in the frozen row schema
live_mechanism_change_lineage: produced by the successor units (063 lineage, 064 dispositions) and not present in the recorded rows

recovery_rate.definition: share of units that recorded a recovery event and nevertheless reached a VERIFIED artifact read-back
missing_inputs: non-empty population: rows with recovery_events > 0 matched 0 of 64 recorded rows

research_to_reproduction_conversion.definition: share of research-function counted units whose reproduction evidence reads back byte-identical from an immutable Git object

successor_lift.definition: combined pass-rate difference between the successor generation and the current generation on the frozen public suite plus evaluator-held holdout cases
missing_inputs: generation_comparison: no generation field exists in the frozen row schema; the value is produced by the generation comparison unit (064) and cannot be derived from work-unit rows
